title: Bodycam: Entitled Woman Bullies Police and Does Yoga

Bodycam footage shows an Illinois woman getting arrested in Whitefish Bay, Wisconsin after a bizarre encounter with police. Officers pulled over Mallory Griffin, 35, after she was allegedly clocked going 60 miles per hour in a 30 zone around 1:30 a.m., according to authorities. Griffin can be seen on dashcam and bodycam briefly driving off from the traffic stop twice before laughing at police and even striking a few yoga poses at the station.
